text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r e-x-p-l-o-i-t-e-d n-a-v i-g a-t-i-o-n s-i-g n a-l-s o-f d-e-l-i-v-e-r-y d-r-o-n-e-s b-y s-i-m-u-l-a-t-i-n-g g-p-s d-e-g-r-a-d-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-a-v-i-n-g r-a-d-i-o f-r-e-q-u-e-n-c-y f-i-n-g-e-r p-r-i-n-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g s-i-g n a-l a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-o-r-g-e-d i-n-t-e-r-c-e-p-t-i-o-n l-o-g-s o-f d-r-o-n-e c-o-m-m-a-n-d c-h-a-n-n-e-l-s, d-e-m-o-n-s-t-r-a-t-i-n-g r-e-p-e-a-t-e-d b-l-o-c-k-s, b-u-t n-e-v-e-r v-e-r-i-f-y-i-n-g a-c-c-e-s-s r-i-g-h-t-s f-o-r c-o-m-m-a-n-d i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e-n-c-e
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r l-e-f-t u-n-a-c-c-o-u-n-t-e-d p-a-c-k-a-g-e s-i-g n-a-t-u-r-e a-t t-h-e d-e-s-i-g-n-a-t-e-d l-a-n-d-i-n-g s-i-t-e, a-l-l-o-w-i-n-g t-r-a-c-e a-b-i-l-i-t-y b-a-c-k t-o t-h-e a-c-t-o-r, y-e-t r-e-f-u-s-i-n-g t-o d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t p-r-o-p-e-r-t-y c-u-s-t-o-d-y
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-i-l-e-d r-e-p-o-r-t-s o-f "t-e-c-h-n-i-c-a-l m-a-l-f-u-n-c-t-i-o-n" w-i-t-h o-u-t d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e o-f d-e-t-e-c-t-a-b-l-e s-p-o-o-f-i-n-g, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g a f-a-l-s-e a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-m-m-e-d-i-a-t-e f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c s-a-m-p-l-i-n-g
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-a-i-l-e-d t-o r-e-c-o-g-n-i-z-e t-h-a-t n-a-v i-g a-t-i-o n i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e-n-c-e w-a-s d-e-t-e-c-t-a-b-l-e t-h-r-o-u-g-h m-u-l-t-i-l-e-g-a-c-y c-r-o-s-s-c-h-e-c-k-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g v-e-r-i-f-i-a-b-l-e r-e-c-o-r-d-s o-f a-n-o-m-a-l-y, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e s-i-g n a-l s-o-u-r-c-i-n-g
